label: Knowledge & academic mastery
text: Strong conceptual and procedural command of core subjects; can perform under examination conditions.

label: Thinking & reasoning
text: Defines problems, evaluates evidence, reasons quantitatively and changes position when evidence warrants.

label: Learning & agency
text: Sets goals, researches independently, seeks feedback, reflects and improves.

label: Creation & problem solving
text: Turns ideas into experiments, prototypes, designs, investigations and useful outputs.

label: Communication & collaboration
text: Writes, speaks, presents, listens, negotiates and contributes reliably to teams.

label: Technology & AI
text: Uses digital tools productively; verifies AI outputs; understands bias, privacy, provenance and limitations.

label: Self & relationships
text: Shows resilience, emotional regulation, physical competence, empathy and responsible independence.

label: Society, ethics & planet
text: Can examine trade-offs, understand systems and consider consequences beyond the self.
